itf-publications.title: ITF Global Tennis Report editions and national reports
itf-publications.scope: Index of 2019, 2021 and 2024 survey editions, with national reports.
itf-publications.limitations: Survey years are not a 1955–2026 annual panel. Mixed-sex participation must not be presented as men-only. Selected national tables are available in the indexed public report; full coverage remains incomplete.

atp-2000-02-21.title: ATP singles ranking archive, 21 February 2000
atp-2000-02-21.limitations: Rankings are outcomes, not direct measurements of popularity, access, coaching or elite support.

itf-2019-cze.title: ITF Global Tennis Report 2019 — Czech Republic participation
itf-2019-cze.scope: Published national participation, clubs and coaches, all sexes. Report label 23 April 2019.
itf-2019-cze.limitations: Edition/report year is not proof of a common observation date for every value. Not men-only, not a historical annual series. Coach count does not measure coaching quality.
